newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs up on spill-over buying from Euroyen market.
newsitem.headline: JGBs up on spill-over buying from Euroyen market.

text.p: Cash and futures JGB were firmer by midday on Tuesday due to buying that spilled over from the bullish Euroyen market, traders said.

On TIFFE, traders, who have paid two, three and four-year fixed interest rates, actively placed buying orders for the Euroyen contracts for hedge purposes after a major long-term bank received fixed interest rates of those maturities, they said.
"JGBs were bought in a bid to catch up with the smooth advance of the Euroyen market," said a trader at a European brokerage house.
